plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Geology A.S. Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 24, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8044/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local GE. Map states Total Units 59 = 15+14+16+14 (all semester headers match their rows; verified). MATH 400 PREREQUISITE NOTE: the map's PRE-REQS column lists 'MATH 370', but the map sequences MATH 372 (Semester 1) then MATH 373 (Semester 2) then MATH 400 (Semester 3), and footnote 2 explicitly states 'MATH 372 and 373 are pre-reqs for MATH 400'. Encoded as MATH 372 + MATH 373 (the sequenced pathway per the footnote); the 'MATH 370' entry appears to be a typo and is documented here, not encoded. CHEM 300 footnote: may be waived with 1 year of high school chemistry with lab and MATH 120 or equivalent; CHEM 300 is pre-req for CHEM 400; meet with a counselor to determine starting course. CHEM 400 pre-req per map: Elementary Algebra and (CHEM 300, 305, 309 or 1 yr HS Chem with lab); encoded as one_of CHEM 300/305/309 (CHEM 305/309 carried under external_prereqs; Elementary Algebra is placement, documented here). CHEM 300 pre-req per map: Elementary Algebra or higher (placement; documented here, not encoded). GEOL 301 pre- or co-requisite per map: GEOL 300 (same semester; encoded). GEOL 311 co-requisite per map: GEOL 310 (same semester; encoded). Advisories (recommended, not required): GEOL 310 advisory GEOL 300 or 305; GEOL 311 advisory GEOL 300 & 301. CRC Area 1A: map recommends meeting with a counselor. This degree is designed to meet common lower-division requirements for a Geology major.
